name: Changhong Huayi Compressor Co., Ltd.
summary: Changhong Huayi Compressor Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of household and commercial compressors under the HUAYI, JIAXIPERA, VELLE, and CUBIGEL brands in China and internationally. The company develops and sells new energy vehicle air-conditioning compressors; fully enclosed piston compressors; raw materials and accessories; and various refrigeration appliances, including refrigerators, freezers, water dispensers, ice makers, and dehumidifiers.
